The rules, briefly

  • 🐈Your cats have agreed to play volleyball. Their commitment ends there.
  • When the ball comes over, tap the cat you want to go for it. They'll act like that was the plan.
  • 🥱Tap a yawning cat to keep them awake. Already asleep? Two taps. And perhaps a stern look.

MATCH POINT

Tug of Paws

Pick your five for the rope. (0 / 5)

The rope, briefly

  • Five of your cats, five of a visiting Cove's, one yarn ball. Pull it past your flag. It's all down to the slot.
  • The meter charges. Hit SPIN and the reels roll. Mostly you'll get 🐈 BIGGER (a random cat swells up and hauls harder) or 💪 HEAVE (the ball jumps your way).
  • ⭐⭐ 7 7 7 ⭐ is rare (~1 in 10) — a huge shove toward your flag. And if the ball's already a third of the way home when you hit it, that's the match.
  • 😴Sometimes it backfires and a cat nods off. The visiting Cove spins too — best luck wins.
🎙️
🐈💪⭐
charging the spin…

Who's on shift?

Pick three cats to run the pop-up café. (0 / 3)

Running the café

  • 🐈Three cats have agreed to run a pop-up café. None of them asked what that involves.
  • ☕🍰🤵Barista makes it, Server carries it, Host seats the guests. Drag a waiting cat onto a clean table, or tap the cat and then its table.
  • 🔀Someone clearly not coping? Drag their card to another role. The swap's instant. The improvement is a hope, not a promise.
  • ⏳You direct service: seat a guest, take their order, prepare it, serve it, then clear the table. Tap tables in the room for each step. Green rings show open seats; the cats walk there themselves. Watch their patience bars.
  • 😼It will not go smoothly. Perfect chaos is the target.
